questions.en: What is the name of the drink invented in Puerto Rico in the 1950s whose Spanish name means "strained pine cone"?

timeline.labelEn: The Caribe Hilton in San Juan, Puerto Rico, dates its invention of the Piña Colada to 1954
timeline.labelDe: Das Caribe Hilton in San Juan, Puerto Rico, datiert die Erfindung der Piña Colada auf 1954

questions.notes: "Piña" means pineapple (literally pine cone), "colada" strained; the hotel's 15 Aug 1954 date and the inventor are disputed, and the name is older.
